reports.note: No thinking mode; temperature 0, seeds 0/1/2. SmolLM2's chat template has no tool support, so it runs with our template: the card's own function-calling prompt and its <tool_call>[…] call list, read by our vLLM parser (closed tags only). The card shows no way to return a tool result; we send results as <tool_response> turns, and after one the model often repeats the result instead of answering in a sentence. The runner rejected 62 Harder trials for combining state-changing calls in one step; the calls parsed successfully. Context 8,192 tokens, output cap 2,048; every prompt fit (largest 6,074 tokens), 8 replies hit the cap and count as failures. Card quickstart sampling (temperature 0.2, top_p 0.9), seed 0 only: 40.5% standard vs 39.3% at temperature 0 seed 0; harder 0% both.

reports.note: Thinking Machines' own sampling from the checkpoint's generation_config (temperature 1.0; the card recommends no other values), thinking on at reasoning_effort 0.9 (the model has no off mode), seeds 0/1/2. Shown at the maker's setting at Ümit's request (#15551); the temperature-0 run it replaces scored 86.5% standard / 91.7% harder, a tie with this row on both sets in a paired test by task (p = 0.14 / 0.22). Served with the maker's vLLM recipe (inkling-2-mini image, inkling tool and reasoning parsers), the only engine that runs the published NVFP4/MXFP8 weights; own load on one GPU. 3.4B active of 26.4B total; three passes through its looped layers make 5.4B effective active per token (card). No reply hit the 32,768-token output cap.
